analysis_md:
$P(x,y)=2xy,Q(x,y)=y^2-x^2,$

$$
\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=2x+2x=4x,
$$

$$
-\frac{1}{P}\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}\right)=-\frac{2}{y},
$$

即积分因子

$$
\mu(y)=e^{\int -\frac{2}{y}\,dy}=y^{-2},
$$
